lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが凛とした姿勢で会社を支えられた
lines.en: Dear, back in our young days, your father carried that company with such a dignified bearing.
lines.style: Slow, wistful opening; low settled voice, savoring the memory, gentle pause before the praise.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、家族の為に尽くされた事を覚えてるわよ、あなた?
lines.en: Mm, and Grandpa — I remember how you gave everything for this family back then too, you know, dear?
lines.style: Warm, papery softness; slow affectionate lilt, a small teasing rise on the final endearment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが詰将棋を毎晩解かれた
lines.en: And your father, dear — every single night back then, he'd sit working through his tsume-shogi problems.
lines.style: Fond half-chuckle under the words; unhurried pace, gaze-in-the-distance remembering tone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、姪の凛子さんを可愛がられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa, back in the day you doted on our niece Rinko so, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle knowing smile in the voice; slow melodic rise blooming into the tag question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが詰将棋月刊誌を毎号購読された
lines.en: You know, dear, your father even took that monthly tsume-shogi magazine — never missed an issue.
lines.style: Quiet amused admiration; measured pace, softening into a contented, settling close.
